note: Voice notes are synthetic (say so in narration). Do not tune pictures, thresholds or prompt. The clean screenshot is shown in an image viewer for two seconds before 'ticket' (open build/images/vpn-clean.png in the viewer, outside the terminal window).
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-10 -l swedencentral -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-10 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-ai-10 failed' }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
python -m mmticket voice --out build/audio   # 5 synthetic voice notes; listen to each once
python -m mmticket transcribe build/audio/vpn-clean.mp3 | Out-Null   # quick check

screens.name: ticket
commands: python -m mmticket ticket --image build/images/vpn-clean.png --audio build/audio/vpn-clean.mp3 --detail high

screens.name: deployments
steps: Open Models + endpoints (or Azure portal > the resource > Deployments)
Open the resource's authentication view and show local (key) authentication disabled
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: conflict
commands: python -m mmticket ticket --image build/images/vpn-conflict.png --audio build/audio/vpn-conflict.mp3 --detail high

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-10 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
